dashboard.label: Splunk Agentic Ops Incident Copilot Dashboard
dashboard.description: An Agentic Platform that reduces noise, correlates signals into incidents, performs MCP-driven investigations, evidence-based RCA, and human-governed remediation with Splunk operational intelligence.

search.query: index=main sourcetype="agentic-ops" | stats count as total_events

index=main sourcetype="agentic-ops" | eval status_code=tonumber(status_code), latency_ms=tonumber(latency_ms), error_type=coalesce(error_type,"null") | eval is_noise=if(status_code<500 AND error_type="null" AND latency_ms<1000,1,0) | stats count(eval(is_noise=1)) as noise_events

index=main sourcetype="agentic-ops" earliest=-24h@h latest=now | eval status_code=tonumber(status_code), latency_ms=tonumber(latency_ms), error_type=coalesce(error_type,"null") | eval is_noise=if(status_code<500 AND error_type="null" AND latency_ms<1000, 1, 0) | stats count as total_events count(eval(is_noise=1)) as noise_events count(eval(is_noise=0)) as signal_events | eval noise_reduction_pct=if(total_events=0,0,round((noise_events/total_events)*100,2)) | eval noise_reduction_pct=tostring(noise_reduction_pct)."%" | fields noise_reduction_pct

index=main sourcetype="agentic-ops" earliest=-1h@h latest=now | eval status_code=tonumber(status_code), latency_ms=tonumber(latency_ms), error_type=coalesce(error_type,"null"), severity=coalesce(severity,"UNKNOWN") | where status_code>=500 OR error_type!="null" | sort 0 - _time | table _time service host endpoint status_code latency_ms error_type severity incident_id | fields _time service host endpoint status_code latency_ms error_type severity incident_id

index=main sourcetype="aiops-correlation" | sort 0 - _time | eval signals=coalesce(mvjoin(signals, ", "), error_type, "unknown") | table _time incident_id service host endpoint incident_class signals correlation_score window event_count | streamstats count as rownum | eval page=ceil(rownum/5) | where page=$page$ | fields - rownum page | fields _time incident_id service host endpoint incident_class signals correlation_score window event_count

index=main sourcetype="agentic-ops" | eval status_code=tonumber(status_code), latency_ms=tonumber(latency_ms), error_type=coalesce(error_type,"null") | eventstats avg(latency_ms) as baseline_avg stdev(latency_ms) as baseline_std by service | eval z_score=if(baseline_std>0,(latency_ms-baseline_avg)/baseline_std,0) | eval signal=case( status_code>=500, "server_error", error_type="database_timeout", "database_timeout", error_type="upstream_api_failure", "dependency_failure", error_type="auth_failure", "auth_failure", error_type="deployment_regression", "deployment_regression", error_type="cpu_saturation", "cpu_saturation", error_type="latency_regression" OR z_score>2.5, "latency_anomaly", true(), "noise" ) | where signal!="noise" | bin _time span=5m | stats count as signal_count values(signal) as signals values(error_type) as error_types values(host) as hosts values(endpoint) as endpoints values(user_region) as regions avg(latency_ms) as avg_latency max(latency_ms) as max_latency dc(trace_id) as affected_traces by _time service incident_id | eval signal_count=tonumber(signal_count) | eval correlation_score=signal_count + mvcount(signals)*2 + mvcount(hosts) | eval severity=case( correlation_score>=20, "HIGH", correlation_score>=10, "MEDIUM", true(), "LOW" ) | where correlation_score>=5 | eval incident_candidate="true" | sort - _time | table _time incident_id service severity signal_count correlation_score signals hosts endpoints regions avg_latency max_latency affected_traces incident_candidate

html.div: Select incident id to investigate and take remediation action: $incident_id$
Click Investigate first for full detail analysis. The action opens in a new tab and leaves the Splunk dashboard untouched.

search.query: index=main sourcetype="aiops-incidents" incident_id!="none" | sort 0 - _time | stats latest(_time) as _time latest(service) as service latest(incident_status) as incident_status latest(severity) as Severity latest(root_cause) as root_cause latest(evidence_summary) as evidence_summary latest(mcp_evidence_summary) as mcp_evidence_summary latest(ai_summary) as ai_summary latest(confidence_score) as confidence_score latest(remediation_status) as remediation_status by incident_id | eval root_cause=coalesce(root_cause,"Pending investigation") | eval mcp_evidence_summary=coalesce(mcp_evidence_summary,evidence_summary,ai_summary,"") | eval ai_summary=coalesce(ai_summary,evidence_summary,"Pending AI summary") | eval confidence_score=if(isnull(confidence_score),"",confidence_score) | eval Remediation=case( remediation_status="CLOSED","Closed", remediation_status="EXECUTED","Executed", remediation_status="APPROVED","Approved", remediation_status="INVESTIGATED","Investigated", remediation_status="TICKET CLOSED","Closed", remediation_status="Remediation Executed","Executed", remediation_status="REJECTED remediation","Rejected", remediation_status="REJECTED","Rejected", true(),"Open" ) | eval mcp_evidence_summary=substr(mcp_evidence_summary,1,180) | sort - _time | rename incident_id as id service as Service Severity as Severity | fields id Service Severity Remediation root_cause mcp_evidence_summary ai_summary confidence_score

index=main (sourcetype="aiops-investigations" OR sourcetype="ai-mcp-triage-agent") incident_id="$incident_id$" | sort 0 - _time | stats latest(_time) as _time latest(service) as service latest(root_cause) as root_cause latest(evidence_summary) as evidence_summary latest(ai_summary) as ai_summary latest(mcp_evidence_summary) as mcp_evidence_summary latest(recommended_actions) as recommended_actions latest(safe_remediation_actions) as safe_remediation_actions latest(confidence_score) as confidence_score by incident_id | eval ai_summary=coalesce(ai_summary,evidence_summary,root_cause,"Investigation details pending.") | eval recommended_actions=coalesce(recommended_actions,"Remediation recommendation pending.") | eval safe_remediation_actions=coalesce(safe_remediation_actions,"Safe remediation action pending.") | table _time incident_id service confidence_score root_cause ai_summary mcp_evidence_summary recommended_actions safe_remediation_actions

index=main sourcetype="aiops-remediation" incident_id!="none" | sort 0 - _time | stats first(remediation_status) as remediation_status by incident_id | eval remediation_status=coalesce(remediation_status,"UNKNOWN") | stats count as incidents by remediation_status | sort - incidents

index=main sourcetype="aiops-investigations" incident_id!="none" | sort 0 - _time | stats first(root_cause) as root_cause by incident_id | eval root_cause=coalesce(root_cause,"unknown") | stats count as incidents by root_cause | sort - incidents

index=main sourcetype="aiops-investigations" incident_id!="none" | sort 0 - _time | stats first(_time) as _time first(service) as service first(root_cause) as root_cause first(confidence_score) as confidence_score first(mcp_investigation) as mcp_investigation first(mcp_evidence_summary) as mcp_evidence_summary first(mcp_tools_used) as mcp_tools_used by incident_id | eval mcp_tools_used=coalesce(mcp_tools_used,"splunk_run_query") | eval mcp_evidence_summary=substr(mcp_evidence_summary,1,220) | fields _time incident_id service root_cause confidence_score mcp_investigation mcp_evidence_summary mcp_tools_used | sort - _time | streamstats count as rownum | eval page=ceil(rownum/5) | where page=$page$ | fields - rownum page | fields _time incident_id service root_cause confidence_score mcp_investigation mcp_evidence_summary mcp_tools_used

index=main sourcetype="aiops-timeline" incident_id!="none" | sort 0 - _time | table _time incident_id service severity status event root_cause remediation_status mcp_investigation | streamstats count as rownum | eval page=ceil(rownum/5) | where page=$page$ | fields - rownum page | fields _time incident_id service severity status event root_cause remediation_status mcp_investigation

index=main sourcetype="aiops-mcp-metrics" | stats sum(mcp_query_count) as queries sum(mcp_success_count) as successes sum(mcp_failure_count) as failures avg(average_investigation_time) as avg_duration_ms by mcp_tool_usage | eval avg_duration_ms=round(avg_duration_ms,2) | sort - queries

index=main sourcetype="aiops-investigations" | eval investigation_source=coalesce(investigation_source,llm_provider,"unknown") | eval investigation_source=case(investigation_source="codex_mcp_agent","Codex MCP agent", investigation_source="codex","Codex", match(investigation_source,"^rules_fallback"),"Deterministic fallback", match(investigation_source,"^fallback_alternative_after_codex"),"Codex fallback", match(investigation_source,"manual_investigation"),"Manual investigation", true(), replace(investigation_source,"_"," ")) | stats count as investigations by investigation_source | sort - investigations

index=main sourcetype="aiops-forecast" | sort 0 - _time | dedup service | eval risk=case(predicted_latency_ms>=3000,"Critical",predicted_latency_ms>=1450,"High",1=1,"Healthy") | stats count(eval(risk="Critical")) as "Predicted Critical Incidents" count as "Services At Risk" avg(confidence_score) as avg_confidence | eval "Avg Forecast Confidence"=round(avg_confidence*100,0)."%" | fields "Predicted Critical Incidents" "Services At Risk" "Avg Forecast Confidence"

index=main sourcetype="aiops-forecast" | sort 0 - _time | dedup service | eval risk=case(predicted_latency_ms>=3000,"Critical",predicted_latency_ms>=1450,"High",1=1,"Healthy") | eval eta=if(risk="Healthy","-",replace(forecast_horizon,"m$"," min")) | eval confidence=tostring(round(confidence_score*100,0))."%" | table _time service risk eta confidence | sort - _time | streamstats count as rownum | eval page=ceil(rownum/5) | where page=$page$ | fields - rownum page | fields _time service risk eta confidence

index=main sourcetype="aiops-ai-assistant" | sort 0 - _time | table _time incident_id service status intent prompt suggested_spl explanation | streamstats count as rownum | eval page=ceil(rownum/5) | where page=$page$ | fields - rownum page | fields _time incident_id service status intent prompt suggested_spl explanation
